description: StorageStore is a discriminated union on kind in ARM (AzureStorageBlobStore: storageAccountId; AzureNetAppFilesStore: netAppVolumeId; both: mountProtocol). The converted model only kept the base kind, so the store's identity was stripped from requests and responses; add the variant fields as optional members.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: AzureStorageBlob: the associated Azure Storage account ID.
AzureNetAppFiles: the associated Azure NetApp Files volume ID.
Protocol used to mount the store: `NFS` or `BlobfuseCaching` (blob only).
